Licensing & Compliance: WHO-GMP Compliant Facilities, ISO 9001:2015, DCGI Approved Formulations, GLP Certified Quality Control Labs

================================================================================
SECTION 1: CORPORATE IDENTITY & INFRASTRUCTURE
================================================================================
Legal Name: ICON DRUGS PRIVATE LIMITED
Brand Name: Icon Drugs
Founding Year: 2002 (25+ Years in Operation)
Corporate Address: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
Contact Email: business@icondrugs.com
Business Scope: Formulation development, solid oral dosage manufacturing (tablets, softgel capsules), liquid orals (syrups, suspensions), sterile parenterals (injections), and topical formulations (gels, ointments).

Quality Infrastructure:
- Modern HVAC-controlled cleanroom production corridors (Class 10,000 / ISO 7 and Class 100 / ISO 5 aseptic filling zones).
- Analytical testing laboratory equipped with High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC), Gas Chromatography (GC), UV-Vis Spectrophotometry, and accelerated stability chambers (ICH Q1A guidelines).
- Continuous in-process quality control (IPQC) monitoring dissolution rate, friability, disintegration time, and content uniformity.

================================================================================
SECTION 2: VERIFIED PRODUCT PORTFOLIO & ACTIVE FORMULATIONS
================================================================================

1. PRENERVE CAPSULES
- Generic Composition: Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg + Alpha Lipoic Acid 100 mg + Benfotiamine 50 mg + Pyridoxine HCl 3 mg + Folic Acid 1.5 mg
- Dosage Form: Hard Gelatin Capsules (Alu-Alu 10x10 pack)
- Category: Neurotrophic Formulation & Nerve Rejuvenator
- Therapeutic Area: Neurology & Neuropathic Pain
- Indications: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy, alcoholic neuropathy, drug-induced neuropathy, sciatica, and radiculopathies.
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/prenerve-caps

2. PRENERVE-NT TABLETS
- Generic Composition: Pregabalin 75 mg + Nortriptyline HCl 10 mg
- Dosage Form: Film-Coated Tablets (Alu-Alu 10x10 pack)
- Category: Dual-Action Neuropathic Analgesic
- Therapeutic Area: Neurology & Chronic Pain
- Indications: Moderate-to-severe neuropathic pain, post-herpetic neuralgia, fibromyalgia, spinal stenosis radiculopathy.
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/prenerve-nt

3. PRENERVE-FORTE CAPSULES
- Generic Composition: Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg + Alpha Lipoic Acid 200 mg + Inositol 100 mg + Benfotiamine 100 mg + Chromium Polynicotinate 200 mcg
- Dosage Form: Hard Gelatin Capsules (Alu-Alu 10x10 pack)
- Category: Advanced Neurovascular & Glycemic Support
- Therapeutic Area: Neurology & Metabolic Health
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/prenerve-forte

4. PRENERVE INJECTION
- Generic Composition: Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg / 2 mL + Niacinamide 100 mg + Pyridoxine HCl 100 mg
- Dosage Form: Sterile Injectable Ampoule (Dispo pack with syringe)
- Category: Rapid Bioavailable Neuro-Nutritional Injectable
- Therapeutic Area: Neurology & Critical Neuro-Deficiencies
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/prenerve-inj

5. PRENERVE GEL
- Generic Composition: Pregabalin 8% w/w + Diclofenac Diethylamine 1.16% w/w + Methyl Salicylate 10% w/w + Menthol 5% w/w
- Dosage Form: Topical Deep Penetrating Gel (30g laminated tube)
- Category: Topical Neuropathic & Musculoskeletal Analgesic
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/prenerve-gel

6. PRECAL SOFTGEL CAPSULES
- Generic Composition: Calcium Carbonate 1250 mg (eq. to elemental Calcium 500 mg) + Calcitriol 0.25 mcg + Vitamin K2-7 45 mcg
- Dosage Form: Soft Gelatin Capsules (Blister 10x10 pack)
- Category: High-Bioavailability Bone Matrix Formulation
- Therapeutic Area: Bone Health & Mineral Metabolism
- Indications: Osteoporosis, osteopenia, post-menopausal bone loss, fracture consolidation.
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/precal-softgels

7. RABICON-DSR CAPSULES
- Generic Composition: Rabeprazole Sodium 20 mg (EC) + Domperidone 30 mg (SR)
- Dosage Form: Sustained Release Capsules (Alu-Alu 10x10 pack)
- Category: Gastroprokinetic & Proton Pump Inhibitor
- Therapeutic Area: Gastroenterology
- Indications: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), erosive esophagitis, non-ulcer dyspepsia, hyperacidity.
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/rabicon-dsr

8. RECOFF-DX SYRUP
- Generic Composition: Dextromethorphan HBr 10 mg + Phenylephrine HCl 5 mg + Chlorpheniramine Maleate 2 mg / 5 mL
- Dosage Form: Oral Liquid Suspension (100 mL PET bottle with measuring cup)
- Category: Triple-Action Antitussive & Decongestant
- Therapeutic Area: Respiratory & Pulmonology
- Indications: Unproductive dry cough, allergic rhinitis, upper respiratory congestion.
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/recoff-dx

9. ALLERKAST TABLETS
- Generic Composition: Levocetirizine Dihydrochloride 5 mg + Montelukast Sodium 10 mg
- Dosage Form: Film-Coated Tablets (Alu-Alu 10x10 pack)
- Category: Dual Antihistamine & Leukotriene Receptor Antagonist
- Therapeutic Area: Respiratory & Allergic Rhinitis
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/allerkast-tab

10. NITOBACT 100 TABLETS
- Generic Composition: Nitrofurantoin 100 mg (Controlled Release / Macrobid formulation)
- Dosage Form: Controlled Release Tablets (Alu-Alu 10x10 pack)
- Category: Targeted Urological Antimicrobial
- Therapeutic Area: Anti-Infectives & Urology
- Indications: Acute uncomplicated urinary tract infections (UTIs) caused by E. coli and Enterococcus faecalis.
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/nitobact-100

11. OCON-OZ TABLETS
- Generic Composition: Ofloxacin 200 mg + Ornidazole 500 mg
- Dosage Form: Film-Coated Tablets (Blister 10x10 pack)
- Category: Broad-Spectrum Fluoroquinolone & Nitroimidazole Combination
- Therapeutic Area: Anti-Infectives & Gastroenterology
- Indications: Mixed gastrointestinal infections, amoebic dysentery, dental infections, pelvic inflammatory disease.
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/ocon-oz

12. SEREK-N TABLETS
- Generic Composition: Nimesulide 100 mg + Paracetamol 325 mg
- Dosage Form: Uncoated Tablets (Blister 10x10 pack)
- Category: Rapid-Onset Analgesic & Antipyretic
- Therapeutic Area: Orthopedics & Acute Pain Management
- URL: https://icondrugs.com/products/serek-n
